title: Long-Distance Transport Credit
content:
## Long-distance transport credit — Medicaid Managed Care Membership

**Clause.** The re-rated copay of an ambulance transport under review is lowered by a long-distance credit that follows the longest one-way trip the transportation benefit shows: a longest trip of at least the far-trip miles of 50 earns the far-trip credit of 1.00 USD, a longest trip of at least the mid-trip miles of 25 earns the mid-trip credit of 0.50 USD, and a shorter longest trip earns no long-distance credit.

The long-distance credit is subtracted from the re-rated ambulance copay, and that copay, after the credits subtracted from it, is never below zero.

The longest trip is the greatest one-way mileage on any trip in the member's Non-Emergency Medical Transportation trip records.

## Mileage bands

| Longest one-way trip | Long-distance credit |
|---|---|
| 50 miles or more | 1.00 USD |
| 25 miles or more, below 50 miles | 0.50 USD |
| Below 25 miles | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical mileages)

- Longest trip exactly 50.0 miles: 1.00 USD.
- Longest trip 49.9 miles: 0.50 USD.
- Longest trip exactly 25.0 miles: 0.50 USD.
- Longest trip 24.9 miles: no credit.

Only the single longest trip decides the band; the number of trips and their total mileage do not.
